name: Sula Vineyards Ltd
title: Sula Vineyards Ltd - 543711 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +7% to INR 142 cr on own brands recovery, but grape-mix shift cut gross margin 350-400 bps; capex to fall below FY26's INR 25 cr, inventory being run down.

capex.quote: our ongoing annual capex requirement is now significantly lower than the INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores levels incurred up to FY '25.

triggers.label: Capex cut to below INR 25 cr
triggers.quote: our ongoing annual capex requirement is now significantly lower than the INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores levels incurred up to FY '25.
triggers.highlight: significantly lower than the INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores

triggers.label: Bulk wine intake controlled
triggers.quote: We have also been able to control the intake of grapes.

triggers.label: Own brands growth returns +5% Q4
triggers.quote: Our own brands grew 5% year -on-year with the elite and premium portfolio leading the way

triggers.label: Price hikes 2-3% in free states
triggers.quote: In general, we would take something like 2% to 3% a year in the free pricing states.
triggers.highlight: 2% to 3% a year in the free pricing states

guidance.metric: Own brands production / sales growth FY27
guidance.value: scale up four launched wines' production ~40%
guidance.quote: we plan to scale up the production of our previous four launches
our capex in terms of Wine Tourism in FY '27 is going to be something like 3x our capex on the winery front.

guidance.value: close to 200-300 bps higher share of revenue in FY27
guidance.quote: I would not be surprised if we close this year up another 200 or 300 basis points

guidance.value: high double digit key growth over next couple of years
guidance.quote: talking about high double digit over the next couple of years

guidance.value: no return to 30% soon; expect YoY margin improvement
guidance.quote: I would not guide that we are going to return to 30% anytime soon.

red_flags.label: Grape contracts mismatch with demand
red_flags.quote: when those sales don't materialize as planned, unfortunately, there is a surfeit for a time of more expensive wine grapes.

red_flags.label: Industry discounting unsustainable
red_flags.quote: the level of discounting is, I would say, unsustainably high for the industry.

evasions.quote: I would not guide that we are going to return to 30% anytime soon.
Having said that, again, I'm not going to guide that it could grow further still.
Unfortunately, we don't provide that information
